description: Urban Forestry Street Trees is Washington DC's inventory of public trees and tree box locations managed by the Urban Forestry Division of the District Department of Transportation, steward of about 175,000 public trees, published on Open Data DC. The layer holds 222,719 rows, including empty and planned tree boxes, with scientific, common, genus and family names, planting date, facility id, address and ward, tree box size and status, overhead wires, curb and sidewalk type, trunk diameter, disease, pests, condition and date, ownership, crown width, height and area from lidar, and elevation. It was first published in February 2015 and was last modified on 29 September 2026. Coverage is the District of Columbia. Format and access: ArcGIS Hub downloads and a REST map service. Licence: CC-BY-4.0; free. Caveats: rows include tree boxes without trees, and private trees are not covered. The wires and condition fields suit tree-on-line outage exposure, alongside urban heat and stormwater studies. Related catalogue records are the NYC 2015 Street Tree Census and the Washington DC sidewalk condition assessment.
